title: Ko‘plik va sanoq
goal_uz: Dars oxirida ko‘plik shaklini to‘g‘ri yasaysiz, sonlardan keyin otni ko‘plikda ishlatasiz, “How many?” bilan savol berasiz va atrofingizdagi narsalarni ingliz tilida sanaysiz.

scenes.title: Yigirmanchi darsga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Yigirmanchi darsga xush kelibsiz. Oldingi darsda odam va narsalarni sifatlar bilan tasvirlashni o‘rgandik: tall, quite old, very beautiful. Bugun esa narsalarni sanashni o‘rganamiz. Ko‘plik shaklini yasaymiz, “How many?” deb so‘raymiz va sonlarni otlar bilan to‘g‘ri ishlatamiz. Dars oxirida atrofingizdagi o‘nta narsani sanab, ingliz tilida nomlay olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back! Last time we described people. Today we count things and learn plurals.
scenes.say_uz: Qaytganingizga xush kelibsiz! O‘tgan safar odamlarni tasvirladik. Bugun narsalarni sanaymiz va ko‘plikni o‘rganamiz.

scenes.title: Birlik va ko‘plik
scenes.say_native: Ingliz tilida sanaladigan otlar ikki shaklda bo‘ladi: birlik va ko‘plik. Bittasi bo‘lsa “a book”, bittadan ko‘p bo‘lsa “books”. O‘zbek tilida ko‘plik qo‘shimchasi “-lar”, ingliz tilida esa asosan “-s”. Lekin katta farq bor: o‘zbekchada “ikkita kitob” deymiz, ya’ni sondan keyin ot birlikda qoladi. Ingliz tilida bunday emas, buni bugun mustahkamlaymiz.
scenes.say: One book, two books. A pen, three pens. English nouns have a singular and a plural form.
scenes.say_uz: Bitta kitob, ikkita kitob. Bitta ruchka, uchta ruchka. Ingliz tilida otlarning birlik va ko‘plik shakli bor.

scenes.title: Oddiy qoida: +s
scenes.say_native: Eng oddiy qoida: otning oxiriga “s” qo‘shamiz. Book — books, pen — pens, car — cars, egg — eggs. Yozuvda “s” ni qo‘shishni unutmang, chunki gapda ko‘plik faqat shu kichkina harf bilan bilinadi. O‘zbek tilida esa ko‘plikni ko‘pincha umuman ko‘rsatmaymiz, shu sabab xato ham shu yerda chiqadi.
scenes.say: Book, books. Pen, pens. Car, cars. Egg, eggs. I have two pens. There are three cars.
scenes.say_uz: Kitob, kitoblar. Ruchka, ruchkalar. Mashina, mashinalar. Tuxum, tuxumlar. Menda ikkita ruchka bor. Uchta mashina bor.

scenes.title: S, X, CH, SH, Z bilan tugasa: +es
scenes.say_native: Agar ot s, x, z, ch yoki sh bilan tugasa, “es” qo‘shamiz: bus — buses, box — boxes, watch — watches, dish — dishes, class — classes. Sababi: bu tovushlardan keyin oddiy “s” ni talaffuz qilib bo‘lmaydi. “Watches” deganda ikki bo‘g‘in eshitiladi: “WO-chiz”.
scenes.say: Bus, buses. Box, boxes. Watch, watches. Dish, dishes. Class, classes.
scenes.say_uz: Avtobus, avtobuslar. Quti, qutilar. Soat, soatlar. Idish, idishlar. Sinf, sinflar.

scenes.title: Undosh + Y: ies
board: but: boy → boys, day → days, key → keys
scenes.say_native: Agar ot undosh harf va “y” bilan tugasa, “y” ni olib tashlab, “ies” qo‘shamiz: city — cities, baby — babies, family — families, country — countries. Lekin “y” dan oldin unli harf bo‘lsa, faqat “s” qo‘shamiz: boy — boys, day — days, key — keys, toy — toys. Farqni eslab qolish uchun “y” dan oldingi harfga qarang: undosh bo‘lsa ies, unli bo‘lsa oddiy s.
scenes.say: City, cities. Baby, babies. Family, families. But boy, boys, and day, days.
scenes.say_uz: Shahar, shaharlar. Chaqaloq, chaqaloqlar. Oila, oilalar. Lekin boy, boys va day, days.

scenes.title: Ko‘plikdagi imlo xatolari
scenes.say_native: Ikki xil xato juda ko‘p uchraydi. Birinchisi: “city” ga shunchaki “s” qo‘shib, “citys” deb yozish. To‘g‘risi “cities”. Ikkinchisi teskarisi: “boy” ni “boies” qilish. To‘g‘risi “boys”, chunki “y” dan oldin unli bor. Har safar yozishdan oldin o‘zingizga savol bering: “y” dan oldin undosh turibdimi yoki unlimi? Javob qaysi qoidani tanlashni aytib beradi.
scenes.say: Not citys, but cities. Not boies, but boys. Look at the letter before the y.
scenes.say_uz: Citys emas, cities. Boies emas, boys. Y dan oldingi harfga qarang.

scenes.title: F, FE va O bilan tugasa
scenes.say_native: Ba’zi otlar f yoki fe bilan tugasa, ko‘plikda “ves” bo‘ladi: knife — knives, leaf — leaves, wife — wives, shelf — shelves. Lekin “roof” — “roofs”, bu istisno. O bilan tugaydigan otlarda ikki holat bor. Tomato — tomatoes va potato — potatoes, ya’ni “es” bilan. Photo — photos va piano — pianos esa oddiy “s” bilan. Bularni yodlab olish kerak.
scenes.say: Knife, knives. Leaf, leaves. Shelf, shelves. Tomato, tomatoes. But photo, photos.
scenes.say_uz: Pichoq, pichoqlar. Barg, barglar. Javon tokchasi, tokchalar. Pomidor, pomidorlar. Lekin photo, photos.

scenes.title: Knifes va tomatos
scenes.say_native: Bu yerda ham ikkita tipik xato bor. “Knife” ga shunchaki “s” qo‘shib, “knifes” deyish noto‘g‘ri, to‘g‘ri shakl “knives”. Xuddi shunday “tomatos” emas, “tomatoes”. Yodlash uchun oddiy hiyla: sabzavotlar, ya’ni tomato va potato “es” oladi, rasm va musiqa so‘zlari, ya’ni photo va piano esa oddiy “s” oladi. Bu to‘liq qoida emas, lekin A1 darajasidagi so‘zlar uchun yaxshi yordamchi.
scenes.say: Knives, not knifes. Tomatoes, not tomatos. Tomatoes and potatoes take es.
scenes.say_uz: Knives, knifes emas. Tomatoes, tomatos emas. Tomatoes va potatoes es oladi.

scenes.title: Ko‘plik shaklini yasang
scenes.say_native: Endi mashq qilamiz. Oltita so‘z bor, ko‘plik shaklini toping: bus, baby, key, knife, dish va potato. Har birining ko‘plik shaklini baland ovozda ayting va imlosini ham o‘ylab ko‘ring. Qaysi qoida ishlashini aniqlang: oddiy s, es, ies yoki ves. Shoshilmang.
scenes.say: Make the plural. Bus. Baby. Key. Knife. Dish. Potato.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘plik shaklini yasang. Bus. Baby. Key. Knife. Dish. Potato.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bus — buses, chunki s bilan tugaydi. Baby — babies, chunki y dan oldin undosh. Key — keys, chunki y dan oldin unli e bor. Knife — knives. Dish — dishes. Potato — potatoes. Agar oltovini topgan bo‘lsangiz, ajoyib, tabriklayman! Adashgan bo‘lsangiz, qoidaga qaytib, yana bir marta o‘qing.
scenes.say: Buses. Babies. Keys. Knives. Dishes. Potatoes.
scenes.say_uz: Buses. Babies. Keys. Knives. Dishes. Potatoes.

scenes.title: Qoidasiz ko‘plik: odamlar
scenes.say_native: Endi qoidaga bo‘ysunmaydigan so‘zlar. Eng muhimlari odamlarga tegishli: man — men, woman — women, child — children, person — people. “People” so‘zi o‘zi ko‘plik, shuning uchun “people are”, ya’ni “odamlar”. “Woman” da o‘qilishi ham o‘zgaradi: birlikda “WU-men”, ko‘plikda “WI-min”.
scenes.say: Man, men. Woman, women. Child, children. Person, people. Two men and three women. Five children.
scenes.say_uz: Erkak, erkaklar. Ayol, ayollar. Bola, bolalar. Shaxs, odamlar. Ikki erkak va uch ayol. Besh bola.

scenes.title: Qoidasiz ko‘plik: tana va hayvonlar
scenes.say_native: Yana bir guruh: foot — feet, tooth — teeth, mouse — mice. Bu yerda unli tovush o‘zgaradi. Ba’zi so‘zlar esa umuman o‘zgarmaydi: sheep — sheep, fish — fish. Ya’ni “one sheep”, “five sheep”, bir xil. Ko‘pincha “fish” ni ham shunday ishlatamiz. Shuning uchun “five sheep” deganda “s” qo‘shmaymiz. Faqat gapdagi son va fe’l sizga ko‘plikni bildiradi.
scenes.say: Foot, feet. Tooth, teeth. Mouse, mice. One sheep, five sheep. One fish, two fish.
scenes.say_uz: Oyoq, oyoqlar. Tish, tishlar. Sichqon, sichqonlar. Bitta qo‘y, beshta qo‘y. Bitta baliq, ikkita baliq.

scenes.title: Childs, mans, peoples
scenes.say_native: Eng keng tarqalgan xato — qoidasiz otlarga ham “s” qo‘shish: “childs”, “mans”, “peoples”, “sheeps”. Bu o‘zbek tilidagi “-lar” odatiga o‘xshab ketadi, chunki biz hamma narsaga bitta qo‘shimcha qo‘shishga o‘rganganmiz. Ingliz tilida bu so‘zlarning tayyor ko‘plik shakli bor: children, men, women, people, sheep. Bu shakllarga qo‘shimcha “s” qo‘shilmaydi.
scenes.say: Not childs, but children. Not peoples, but people. Not sheeps, but sheep.
scenes.say_uz: Childs emas, children. Peoples emas, people. Sheeps emas, sheep.

scenes.title: Doim ko‘plikdagi so‘zlar

examples.t: I need a pair of scissors.

scenes.say_native: Ba’zi narsalar ikkita qismdan iborat, shuning uchun ingliz tilida doim ko‘plikda: trousers, jeans, glasses, scissors, shorts. “My jeans are new”, ya’ni “is” emas, “are”. Bitta narsani aytmoqchi bo‘lsak, “a pair of” deymiz: “a pair of trousers”, “two pairs of jeans”. O‘zbekchada “shim”, “ko‘zoynak” birlikda, ingliz tilida esa ko‘plik.
scenes.say: Trousers, jeans, glasses, scissors. A pair of trousers. Two pairs of jeans. My jeans are new.
scenes.say_uz: Shim, jinsi, ko‘zoynak, qaychi. Bir juft shim. Ikki juft jinsi. Mening jinsim yangi.

scenes.title: Ko‘plik yoki birlik?
scenes.say_native: Beshta so‘z bor, ularning ko‘plik shaklini ayting: child, woman, tooth, mouse va person. Hammasi qoidasiz so‘zlar, shuning uchun siz ularni xotiradan topishingiz kerak. Esda tuting: person so‘zining ko‘pligi umuman boshqa so‘z. Baland ovozda javob bering.
scenes.say: Plural, please. Child. Woman. Tooth. Mouse. Person.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘plikni ayting. Child. Woman. Tooth. Mouse. Person.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Child — children. Woman — women. Tooth — teeth. Mouse — mice. Person — people. Ko‘rdingizmi, bularning birortasida ham oddiy “s” yo‘q. Agar hammasini to‘g‘ri topgan bo‘lsangiz, yaxshi natija. Xato qilgan so‘zlaringizni daftarga yozib qo‘ying.
scenes.say: Children. Women. Teeth. Mice. People.
scenes.say_uz: Children. Women. Teeth. Mice. People.

scenes.title: Son + ko‘plikdagi ot
scenes.say_native: Endi eng muhim qoida. Bir bo‘lsa, ot birlikda: one book. Ikki, uch, o‘n va undan ko‘p bo‘lsa, ot albatta ko‘plikda: two books, ten books, twenty students. O‘zbek tilida esa “ikkita kitob”, “o‘nta talaba”, ot birlikda qoladi. Shuning uchun o‘zbek tilida so‘zlashuvchilar ingliz tilida “two book” deb xato qilishadi. Ingliz tilida ko‘plikni faqat otning o‘zi ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: One apple. Two apples. Six apples. Ten books. Twenty students.
scenes.say_uz: Bitta olma. Ikkita olma. Oltita olma. O‘nta kitob. Yigirmata talaba.

scenes.title: Two book emas, two books
scenes.say_native: Mana, o‘zbek tili ta’siridagi eng katta xato. “Menda ikkita opa bor” — o‘zbekchada “opa” birlikda. Inglizchaga so‘zma-so‘z o‘girsangiz, “two sister” chiqadi, bu noto‘g‘ri. To‘g‘risi: “I have two sisters”. Qoida oddiy: bir dan ko‘p bo‘lsa, ot oxirida “s” bo‘lishi shart. Gap yozayotganda yoki gapirayotganda sondan keyingi otni tekshiring, “s” bormi?
scenes.say: Not two book, but two books. I have three sisters.
scenes.say_uz: Two book emas, two books. Mening uchta opa-singlim bor.

scenes.title: There is va there are

examples.t: There is a pen on the table.
There are five pens on the table.

scenes.say_native: Narsa bor-yo‘qligini aytganda “there is” va “there are” ishlatamiz. Bitta narsa bo‘lsa, “there is one chair”. Ikki va undan ko‘p bo‘lsa, “there are two chairs”. Ya’ni fe’l ham sonni kuzatadi. O‘zbek tilida “bor” har doim bir xil, ingliz tilida esa is va are alohida ishlatiladi. Bu juda muhim ko‘nikma, mashq qilamiz.
scenes.say: There is one chair. There are two chairs. There are ten students.
scenes.say_uz: Bitta stul bor. Ikkita stul bor. O‘nta talaba bor.

scenes.title: There is three emas
scenes.say_native: Mana yana bir tipik xato: “There is three chairs”. O‘zbekchada “uchta stul bor” deymiz va “bor” o‘zgarmaydi, shu sabab xato kelib chiqadi. Ingliz tilida esa uchta stul ko‘plik, demak “there are three chairs”. Teskarisi ham noto‘g‘ri: bitta kitob uchun “there are a book” emas, “there is a book”. Qoida: bitta bo‘lsa is, ko‘p bo‘lsa are.
scenes.say: There are three chairs. There is a book. One thing: is. Many things: are.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta stul bor. Bitta kitob bor. Bitta narsa: is. Ko‘p narsa: are.

scenes.title: Sonlar: 11 dan 20 gacha va o‘nliklar
scenes.say_native: Sonlarni qisqacha eslaymiz. O‘n birdan o‘n to‘qqizgacha: eleven, twelve, thirteen, fourteen va hokazo, nineteen. O‘nliklar: twenty, thirty, forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety. Ikki holatga e’tibor bering. “Forty” da u harfi yo‘q, “fourteen” da esa bor. Yana urg‘u: thirTEEN va THIRty. “-teen” da urg‘u oxirida, “-ty” da boshida.
scenes.say: Eleven, twelve, thirteen, fourteen, nineteen, twenty, thirty, forty, fifty, ninety.
scenes.say_uz: O‘n bir, o‘n ikki, o‘n uch, o‘n to‘rt, o‘n to‘qqiz, yigirma, o‘ttiz, qirq, ellik, to‘qson.

scenes.title: Hundred va thousand
scenes.say_native: Yuz — “a hundred” yoki “one hundred”. Mingni “a thousand” deymiz. Yuz va minglikdan keyin, agar ular son bilan kelsa, “s” qo‘shilmaydi: “three hundred books”, “two thousand people”. Britaniya ingliz tilida yuzdan keyin ko‘pincha “and” aytiladi: “two hundred and fifty”. Lekin “hundreds of people” desak, ma’no boshqa: yuzlab odamlar, ya’ni aniq son emas.
scenes.say: A hundred. Two hundred and fifty. A thousand. Three hundred books. Two thousand people.
scenes.say_uz: Yuz. Ikki yuz ellik. Ming. Uch yuz kitob. Ikki ming odam.

scenes.title: Three hundreds emas
scenes.say_native: Bu xato aslida sanoq tizimidan kelib chiqadi. Ba’zi o‘quvchilar “three hundreds” yoki “two thousands” deb yozadi, chunki ko‘plikdagi ot oxirida s kerak deb o‘ylaydi. Lekin hundred va thousand son sifatida ishlatilganda o‘zgarmaydi: three hundred, two thousand. Otning o‘zi esa baribir ko‘plikda: “three hundred students”. Ya’ni “s” faqat otda, sonda emas.
scenes.say: Three hundred students. Two thousand books. No s on hundred or thousand.
scenes.say_uz: Uch yuz talaba. Ikki ming kitob. Hundred va thousand ga s qo‘shilmaydi.

scenes.title: Sonni va otni ayting
scenes.say_native: Endi sonlarni otlar bilan birga mashq qilamiz. Beshta ibora yasang. Birinchi son, keyin ot ko‘plikda. Uch ruchka, o‘n ikki quti, yigirma shahar, besh erkak va yuz pichoq. Ko‘plik shaklini to‘g‘ri tanlashni unutmang: quti, shahar, erkak va pichoq uchun alohida qoidalar bor. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Say the number and the noun. Three pen. Twelve box. Twenty city. Five man. One hundred knife.
scenes.say_uz: Son va otni ayting. Uch ruchka. O‘n ikki quti. Yigirma shahar. Besh erkak. Yuz pichoq.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Three pens, oddiy s. Twelve boxes, chunki x bilan tugaydi. Twenty cities, chunki undosh va y. Five men, qoidasiz ko‘plik. A hundred knives, chunki fe, ves bo‘ladi. Yana bir bor eslatib o‘taman: sondan keyin ot har doim ko‘plikda. Bu qoida bir dan ko‘p har qanday son uchun ishlaydi.
scenes.say: Three pens. Twelve boxes. Twenty cities. Five men. A hundred knives.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta ruchka. O‘n ikkita quti. Yigirmata shahar. Beshta erkak. Yuzta pichoq.

scenes.title: How many...?
board: How many books do you have?

examples.t: How many books do you have?

scenes.say_native: Sanoq haqida so‘rash uchun “How many” ishlatamiz. O‘zbekcha “nechta” degani. Tuzilishi: How many, keyin ko‘plikdagi ot, keyin yordamchi fe’l. “How many books do you have?” yoki “How many students are there?”. Muhim: “How many” dan keyin ot doim ko‘plikda. O‘zbekchada “nechta kitob” desak ham, ingliz tilida “how many book” deyish xato. Albatta “books” kerak.
scenes.say: How many books do you have? How many students are there? How many chairs are there?
scenes.say_uz: Sizda nechta kitob bor? Nechta talaba bor? Nechta stul bor?

scenes.title: How many ga javob

examples.t: How many brothers do you have? Two.

scenes.say_native: Javob berish juda oson. To‘liq gap: “I have two brothers” yoki “There are twenty students”. Qisqa javob ham mumkin: shunchaki “Two” yoki “Five”. Aniq bilmasangiz, “about ten” deysiz, ya’ni taxminan o‘nta. Hech narsa bo‘lmasa “None” deymiz, ya’ni “bitta ham yo‘q”.
scenes.say: How many brothers do you have? Two. How many chairs are there? About ten. None.
scenes.say_uz: Nechta akangiz bor? Ikkita. Nechta stul bor? Taxminan o‘nta. Hech qanday.

scenes.title: How many va How much
board: How many books? / How many people?
How much water? / How much money?

examples.t: How much water do you drink?

scenes.say_native: Ikkita so‘rov bor. Nimani sanash mumkin bo‘lsa, “How many” ishlatamiz: books, students, chairs. Sanab bo‘lmaydigan narsalar uchun, masalan suv, pul, vaqt, “How much”. Bu yerda ot ko‘plik shaklini olmaydi, ya’ni oxirida s bo‘lmaydi: “How much water”, “How much money”. Ot oxirida s bo‘lmaydi.
scenes.say: How many books? How many people? How much water? How much money? How many cups of tea?
scenes.say_uz: Nechta kitob? Nechta odam? Qancha suv? Qancha pul? Necha chashka choy?

scenes.title: How many book emas
board: ✗ How many book do you have?
✓ How many books do you have?
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi: “How many book”. O‘zbekchada “nechta kitob” desak ham, inglizchada “books” bo‘lishi shart. Ikkinchisi: “How much students”. “Much” faqat sanalmaydigan narsalarga ishlatiladi, talabalarni esa sanab chiqish mumkin. Qoida oddiy: sanasangiz, “How many” va ko‘plik. Sanay olmasangiz, masalan suv yoki pul, “How much”. Bu ikkita xatoni hamma o‘rganuvchilar bir marta qilib ko‘radi.
scenes.say: How many books do you have? How many students are there? Not how many book.
scenes.say_uz: Sizda nechta kitob bor? Nechta talaba bor? How many book emas.

scenes.title: Savol tuzing
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol tuzing. Pen in your bag: sumkangizda nechta ruchka bor. Student in the class: sinfda nechta talaba. Brother you have: nechta akangiz bor. Window in the room: xonada nechta deraza bor. Har birini “How many” bilan boshlang va ot ko‘plikda bo‘lsin. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Ask four questions with how many. Pen, student, brother, window.
scenes.say_uz: How many bilan to‘rtta savol bering. Ruchka, talaba, aka-uka, deraza.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: How many pens are there in your bag?
How many students are there in the class?
How many brothers do you have?
How many windows are there in the room?
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “How many pens are there in your bag?” Ikkinchi: “How many students are there in the class?” Uchinchi: “How many brothers do you have?” To‘rtinchi: “How many windows are there in the room?” Barchasida bir xil tuzilma bor: How many, ko‘plikdagi ot, savol shakli. Shuni eslab qolsangiz, istalgan savol tuza olasiz.
scenes.say: How many students are there in the class? How many brothers do you have? How many windows are there?
scenes.say_uz: Sinfda nechta talaba bor? Nechta akangiz bor? Nechta deraza bor?

scenes.title: Talaffuz: -s ning uch tovushi
scenes.say_native: Ko‘plik “s” uch xil o‘qiladi. Jarangsiz tovushdan keyin, p, t, k, f kabi, u “s” bo‘ladi: cats, books, hats. Jarangli tovushdan va unlidan keyin “z” bo‘ladi: dogs, pens, days. S, z, sh, ch va x dan keyin esa qo‘shimcha bo‘g‘in “iz” eshitiladi: buses, watches, boxes. Eng ko‘p xato: hamma joyda “s” o‘qish. Masalan, “dogs” oxirida “s” emas, “z” eshitiladi.
scenes.say: Cats, books, hats. Dogs, pens, days. Buses, watches, boxes.
scenes.say_uz: Mushuklar, kitoblar, shlyapalar. Itlar, ruchkalar, kunlar. Avtobuslar, soatlar, qutilar.

scenes.title: Takrorlang
scenes.say_native: Endi takrorlang. Birinchi qator: cats, books, hats, oxirida yengil “s”. Ikkinchi qator: dogs, pens, days, oxirida jarangli “z”. Uchinchi qator: buses, watches, boxes, oxirida alohida bo‘g‘in “iz”. Har bir so‘zni men aytganimdan keyin takrorlang va farqni quloqqa o‘rgating. Tez gapirmang, aniq gapiring.
scenes.say: Cats, books, hats. Dogs, pens, days. Buses, watches, boxes.
scenes.say_uz: Mushuklar, kitoblar, shlyapalar. Itlar, ruchkalar, kunlar. Avtobuslar, soatlar, qutilar.

scenes.title: Tinglang: kanselyariya do‘konida
board: A: Hello. I need some things for school.
B: How many pens do you want?
A: Five pens and two notebooks, please.
B: Anything else? A: Ten pencils.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. Maktab uchun narsalar sotib olmoqchi bo‘lgan mijoz kanselyariya do‘koniga kirdi. Sotuvchi nechta ruchka kerakligini so‘raydi. Mijoz sonlarni va narsalarni aytadi. Diqqat qiling: sondan keyin hamma otlar ko‘plikda keladi: pens, notebooks, pencils. Savollar: nechta ruchka, nechta daftar va nechta qalam sotib olindi?
scenes.say: Hello. I need some things for school. How many pens do you want? Five pens and two notebooks, please. Anything else? Yes, ten pencils.
scenes.say_uz: Salom. Maktab uchun ba’zi narsalar kerak. Nechta ruchka kerak? Beshta ruchka va ikkita daftar, iltimos. Yana nimadir? Ha, o‘nta qalam.

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
scenes.say_native: Dialogni eslab, uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: sotuvchi nechta ruchka sotdi? Ikkinchi: nechta daftar? Uchinchi: nechta qalam? Javobingiz to‘liq gap bo‘lishi shart emas, lekin son va ot to‘g‘ri bo‘lsin. Baland ovozda ayting, keyin to‘g‘ri javobni eshitasiz.
scenes.say: How many pens? How many notebooks? How many pencils?
scenes.say_uz: Nechta ruchka? Nechta daftar? Nechta qalam?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Ruchkalar: five pens, beshta. Daftarlar: two notebooks, ikkita. Qalamlar: ten pencils, o‘nta. Hammasi ko‘plikda, chunki sondan keyin ot albatta “s” oladi. Bu qoidani esda tuting. Dialogda mijoz qisqa gapirdi: “Five pens and two notebooks, please”. Bu tabiiy usul, chunki do‘konda to‘liq gap shart emas. Qisqa, aniq so‘z va “please” yetarli.
scenes.say: Five pens. Two notebooks. Ten pencils.
scenes.say_uz: Beshta ruchka. Ikkita daftar. O‘nta qalam.

scenes.title: Tinglang: oila haqida
board: A: Do you have any brothers or sisters?
B: Yes, I have two brothers and one sister.
A: How many children are there in your family?
B: Three. And two grandparents live with us.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Ikki yangi tanish oilalari haqida gaplashmoqda. Birinchisi aka-uka va opa-singillari bor-yo‘qligini so‘raydi. Ikkinchisi aytadi: ikkita akasi va bitta singlisi bor. Diqqat qiling: “two brothers” ko‘plikda, “one sister” birlikda, “children” esa qoidasiz ko‘plik. Savollar: oilada nechta bola bor va ularning bobo-buvilari nechta?
scenes.say: Do you have any brothers or sisters? Yes, I have two brothers and one sister. How many children are there in your family? Three. And two grandparents live with us.
scenes.say_uz: Aka-uka yoki opa-singillaringiz bormi? Ha, ikkita akam va bitta singlim bor. Oilangizda nechta bola bor? Uchta. Biz bilan ikkita bobo-buvi yashaydi.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: 3) How many children in the family?
scenes.say_native: Dialog bo‘yicha to‘rtta savol. Nechta aka bor? Nechta singil bor? Oilada jami nechta bola? Ular bilan kim yashaydi? Javoblarni baland ovozda, ko‘plik va birlikka e’tibor berib ayting. Agar bilmasangiz, dialogni qayta eslang. Bir oz o‘ylash vaqti beriladi, keyin javoblarni birgalikda tekshiramiz.
scenes.say: How many brothers? How many sisters? How many children are there? Who lives with them?
scenes.say_uz: Nechta aka? Nechta singil? Nechta bola bor? Ular bilan kim yashaydi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Ikkita aka: two brothers. Bitta singil: one sister, birlikda. Oilada uchta bola: three children, bu yerda “childs” emas. Va ular bilan ikkita bobo-buvi yashaydi: two grandparents. Ko‘rdingizmi, bitta dialogda deyarli hamma qoidalar bor: sondan keyin ko‘plik, one bilan birlik va qoidasiz children. Endi o‘zingiz uchun xuddi shunday gapirish vaqti keldi.
scenes.say: Two brothers. One sister. Three children. Two grandparents.
scenes.say_uz: Ikkita aka. Bitta singil. Uchta bola. Ikkita bobo-buvi.

scenes.title: Atrofingizni sanang
board: How many ... are there in your room?
scenes.say_native: Endi sizning navbatingiz. Atrofingizga qarang va narsalarni sanang. Kamida to‘rtta gap ayting: “There are two windows”, “There is one table”, “I have three books”. Birlik va ko‘plikni to‘g‘ri tanlang: bitta narsa uchun is, bir nechta uchun are va ot ko‘plikda. Gaplarni baland ovozda ayting, keyin namuna javobni eshiting.
scenes.say: Count the things around you. Use there is and there are. I will give you a model answer.
scenes.say_uz: Atrofingizdagi narsalarni sanang. There is va there are dan foydalaning. Men namuna javob beraman.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: There are two windows in my room.
There is one table and four chairs.
I have ten books and three pens.

examples.t: There is one table and four chairs.
examples.uz: Bitta stol va to‘rtta stul bor.

scenes.say_native: Mana namuna. “There are two windows in my room. There is one table and four chairs. I have ten books and three pens.” Birlikda “is” va “a” yoki “one”, ko‘plikda “are” va s. Narsa bo‘lmasa, “no” desak bo‘ladi: “There are no cats”. Sizning gaplaringiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi qoidalar bir xil. Ular to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa, siz hozir birinchi marta yaxshi tabiiy ingliz tilida gapirdingiz.
scenes.say: There are two windows in my room. There is one table and four chairs. I have ten books and three pens.
scenes.say_uz: Xonamda ikkita deraza bor. Bitta stol va to‘rtta stul bor. Menda o‘nta kitob va uchta ruchka bor.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
board: men, women, children, people, feet, teeth
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Birinchi: ko‘plik asosan s bilan yasaladi, ba’zan es, ies yoki ves. Ikkinchi: man, woman, child, person, foot, tooth, mouse qoidasiz ko‘plikka ega. Uchinchi: sondan keyin ot ko‘plikda, “two books”, “three hundred students”. To‘rtinchi: “How many” dan keyin ko‘plikdagi ot. Beshinchi: “There is” bitta narsaga, “there are” bir nechtasiga. Bu besh narsani bilsangiz, siz hammasini bilasiz.
scenes.say: Today: plurals, irregular plurals, numbers with nouns, how many, and there is, there are.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun: ko‘plik, qoidasiz ko‘plik, sonlar va otlar, how many, hamda there is va there are.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Check s, es, ies, irregular plurals
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa: atrofingizdagi o‘nta narsani sanab, ingliz tilida yozing va baland ovozda ayting. Masalan: “There are three chairs”. Mezon: kamida beshta gapda ko‘plik bo‘lsin, bitta narsada birlik bo‘lsin, hech qaysi gapda “two book” kabi xato bo‘lmasin, va kamida bitta qoidasiz ko‘plik, masalan, men yoki children. Keyingi darsda kishilik va egalik olmoshlarini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Homework: count ten things around you. Write sentences with numbers and plural nouns. See you in the next lesson!
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifa: atrofingizdagi o‘nta narsani sanang. Sonlar va ko‘plikdagi otlar bilan gap yozing. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz!

homework_uz: Atrofingizdagi 10 ta narsani sanab, ingliz tilida nomlang: masalan, “There are three chairs. There is one table.” Mezon: kamida 5 ta gapda ko‘plik bo‘lsin, kamida bitta qoidasiz ko‘plik (men, women, children) ishlating, “two book” kabi xato bo‘lmasin. Gaplarni yozing va baland ovozda o‘qing. Keyingi darsda kishilik va egalik olmoshlarini o‘rganamiz.

quiz.why_uz: Sondan keyin ot ko‘plikda bo‘ladi: two sisters.
Undosh + y bo‘lsa, y tushib ies qo‘shiladi.
Y dan oldin unli (o) bo‘lgani uchun faqat s qo‘shiladi.

options: How many book do you have?
How much books do you have?
How many books do you have?
quiz.why_uz: How many dan keyin ko‘plikdagi ot keladi, so‘ng do you have.

quiz.q: There ___ five chairs in the room.

quiz.why_uz: Hundred sondan keyin s olmaydi, lekin ot ko‘plikda: three hundred students.
S bilan tugagan otlar ko‘plikda qo‘shimcha bo‘g‘in /ɪz/ oladi.
Sanaladigan otlar uchun how many va ko‘plik ishlatiladi.
